Project.Name: ECG Time Series Analysis and Static Web Demo
Project.Title: ECG WBS and illustrative budget scenario

Task.Name: ECG Time Series Analysis and Static Web Demo
Phase 1: Initiation and integrated planning
Project charter, scope and acceptance criteria
Task.Notes: Charter names the ECG research/demo objective, users, exclusions, deliverables, acceptance criteria and risks; team reviews it.

Task.Name: Integrated WBS, schedule and resource plan
Task.Notes: Every work package has one owner, estimated work, duration, dependency and completion evidence; six-person load is checked.

Task.Name: Quality, risk and communication baseline with plan review
Task.Notes: Quality checks, key data/model/demo risks and the weekly update channel are recorded; the baseline version is ready for team review. Phase 1 closes when the six-member team reviews the charter and baseline.

Task.Name: Phase 2: ECG data foundation
MIT-BIH inventory and ECG exploration baseline
Task.Notes: Record list, lead/sampling details, annotations, basic signal/label plots and source provenance are reproducible.

Task.Name: Preprocessed ECG and HR/RR dataset with data review
Task.Notes: Filtering, R-peak handling, HR/RR derivation, windowing, record-level split and checks against overlapping-window leakage are documented. Phase 2 closes when the data lead records the data-readiness check.

Task.Name: Phase 3: Analysis and model evidence
ARIMA/SARIMA forecasting results
Task.Notes: Forecast configuration, held-out period, MAE/RMSE and reproducible plots are recorded with the exact model orders used.

Task.Name: ML/CNN classification results
Task.Notes: Feature-based ML and 1D CNN results include record-level split, confusion matrix, F1/AUC and each method's window-label rule; comparisons state limits.

Task.Name: ST-MEM evaluation and combined model review
Task.Notes: Checkpoint provenance, fine-tuning setup, test metrics and difference from the earlier report are explicit; demo uses saved results only. Phase 3 closes after the ARIMA/SARIMA, ML/CNN and ST-MEM leads review all three result sets together.

Task.Name: Phase 4: Static web demo
Static analysis pages and prepared demo data
Task.Notes: Overview, ECG exploration, preprocessing, forecast and classification pages load prepared data and show source/limitations for metrics.

Task.Name: ECG replay monitor, integration and demo review
Task.Notes: Recorded ECG replay, HR/RR trends and completed-window ST-MEM scores work offline; no live diagnosis or upload is implied. Phase 4 closes after the integrated demo is reviewed against the scope and limitations.

Task.Name: Phase 5: Verification and final report
Verification evidence and issue resolution
Task.Notes: Data, model, web and replay checks are logged; major issues are fixed or listed with owner and impact; metrics match their source files.

Task.Name: Final project report, user guide and quality review
Task.Notes: Report explains scope, method, WBS, schedule, roles, risks, evidence and limitations; guide shows how to open and reproduce the demo. Phase 5 closes after the report and QA evidence are checked together.

Task.Name: Phase 6: Acceptance and handover
User acceptance and final corrections
Task.Notes: Acceptance checklist is run on the delivered demo/report; defects are corrected or explicitly accepted with limitations.

Task.Name: Handover package, retrospective and final acceptance
Task.Notes: Source, generated data, report, setup/usage instructions and decision log are handed over; team records lessons learned. Phase 6 closes when final acceptance and handover are recorded.
